verdict.rationale: Dagster provides a CLI-based scaffolding workflow (create-dagster, dg scaffold defs), Python API for defining assets/jobs, dg dev for local run/serving, and a documented Docker deployment path for headless execution, plus a dedicated AI-agent skill and MCP server to guide agents through this workflow. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence of an agent actually completing an end-to-end scaffold-configure-run cycle unattended, and no REST/OpenAPI API surface confirmed (probe found only 404s) for fully API-driven headless runs.
